title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 3
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: The Secret Doctrine, Volume 3, by H. P. Blavatsky, from the multi-volume edition of her 1888 work. This part is chiefly devoted to Anthropogenesis, the esoteric history of humanity based on further Stanzas of Dzyan. Blavatsky describes the evolution of humankind through seven 'root races': the ethereal, sexless first race of the Imperishable Sacred Land, the Hyperborean second race, the Lemurian third race, in which humanity separated into sexes and received mind from the Manasaputras or 'Sons of Mind', the giant Atlanteans of the fourth race and their catastrophic destruction, and the present fifth (Aryan) race. She interweaves myths of giants, fallen angels, the Flood and lost continents with critiques of Darwinian evolution. These racial theories reflect nineteenth-century thinking and are now widely criticised. Volume divisions vary between editions, so readers should consult the contents.
